name: db-astro-suite
description: A suite of Astro tools with Python backends and Go generators.

scripts.build: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist && rm -rf dist && pnpm sitemap && pnpm redirects && pnpm build:hub && pnpm build:starwizz && pnpm build:astrogram && pnpm build:merge
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network host -e SKIP_NATIVE_DEPS_TESTS=1 -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:docker:behaviour: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network host -e SKIP_NATIVE_DEPS_TESTS=1 -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble npx playwright test --grep-invert "[Vv]isual"
scripts.test:e2e:docker:visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network host -e SKIP_NATIVE_DEPS_TESTS=1 -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble npx playwright test --grep "[Vv]isual"
scripts.test:e2e:docker:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network host -e SKIP_NATIVE_DEPS_TESTS=1 -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble npx playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.build:flatten: mkdir -p dist/tool && (cp dist/about/index.html dist/about.html 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp dist/tool/astrogram/index.html dist/tool/astrogram.html 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp dist/tool/starwizz/index.html dist/tool/starwizz.html 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp dist/tool/file-grouper/index.html dist/tool/file-grouper.html 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:merge: mkdir -p dist/starwizz dist/astrogram && (cp -rf hub/dist/analog/public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || cp -rf hub/dist/client/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -rf tools/starwizz/dist/starwizz/browser/* dist/starwizz/ 2>/dev/null || cp -rf tools/starwizz/dist/starwizz/* dist/starwizz/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -rf tools/astrogram/dist/astrogram/browser/* dist/astrogram/ 2>/dev/null || cp -rf tools/astrogram/dist/astrogram/* dist/astrogram/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp dist/index.html dist/404.html 2>/dev/null || true) && pnpm build:flatten
